_comment: Optional overrides for compositor-next session binds. Defaults are baked in compositor-next/src/binds.rs (beacon, lock, workspaces, terminal, …). Each override: { "id", "mods": ["super"], "key", "action": { "shell": ["chrome","beacon"] } | { "dispatch": "workspace 2" } | { "exec": ["proteus-terminal"] } }. Copy to ~/.config/proteus/keybinds.json to customize; then: proteus-compositorctl dispatch reloadbinds
